trigger: The frozen first valid CARRY-PNL-0031 run passed its preregistered gates but reported unusually large daily-close basis minima, approximately -16.9% for SOLUSDT and -6.7% for XRPUSDT.
purpose: Validate source/timestamp consistency and quantify PNL influence of observed basis outliers before any BRRK stack experiment. This audit has no authority to alter the frozen 0031 portfolio or result.

source_rule.monthly_primary: official Binance spot and USD-M perpetual monthly 1d archives
source_rule.daily_crosscheck: official corresponding spot and USD-M perpetual daily 1d archive for each selected outlier date and its immediately prior day when available

selection_for_audit_only.ranked_dates: top 20 dates by absolute daily-close basis = abs(perp_close / spot_close - 1) within the frozen 0031 evaluation window
selection_for_audit_only.absolute_basis_flag: also report every date with abs(basis) >= 0.02
selection_for_audit_only.note: 2% is a diagnostic materiality flag only; it is not a trading threshold and cannot change 0031 holdings

required_checks: identify exact dates and spot/perp closes for ranked basis observations
compare monthly-archive closes with exact official daily-archive closes for both legs on selected dates
verify selected rows map to the same UTC open date
report relative monthly-vs-daily close disagreement for each leg
compute daily basis change and the frozen 0031 asset price-spread contribution = 0.10 * spot_return - 0.10 * perp_return
quantify how much of each asset's cumulative additive 0031 price-spread contribution is attributable to top outlier dates
inspect prior/next-day basis around the largest events to distinguish persistent dislocation from one-day snapback
do not recompute an alternative filtered strategy

pass_rule.archive_consistency: all ranked dates with available official daily archives reproduce monthly spot and perp closes to relative tolerance <= 1e-10; unavailable daily files must be disclosed
pass_rule.timestamp_consistency: all compared daily and monthly rows resolve to the same requested UTC date
pass_rule.decision: PASS means the extreme observations are source-consistent enough for 0031 to proceed to a separately preregistered stack test; FAIL blocks stacking pending source resolution

prohibited: no removal of SOL, XRP or any outlier date
no alternative price source inserted into 0031
no re-estimation of 0031 performance after excluding audited observations
